text:
maya: quick design review — refreshed bulk credential UX with emphasis on download affordance and mixed-type hints. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/bulk-cred-v2

maya: three asks:
1) Does the selection summary make mixed types clear enough? (api keys, service tokens, oauth apps)
2) Modal vs inline drawer for multi-select confirm (threshold suggestion = 6)
3) Microcopy for download CTA and undo affordances

owen: engineering constraints & proposals:
- Different item types have differing server-side semantics (service tokens require regen via server; oauth apps may need webhooks updated). UI must annotate these before confirm.
- For >6 items, prefer modal so users cant accidentally trigger at scale; for <=6 use contextual drawer to keep row context visible.
- Backend will queue large rotate jobs; show queued state rather than immediate error and return an estimated completion time.
- Plan: optimistic UI updates with polling fallback; store per-item status (queued/running/success/fail).

li: accessibility checklist:
- Modal: role="dialog" aria-modal="true" with aria-labelledby -> header id, aria-describedby -> short summary.
- Add aria-live region to announce progress: "Rotating 2 of 7 credentials".
- Make "Download CSV" an actual button focusable via keyboard; for screen readers read "Download CSV with new credentials".
- Ensure secret reveal has accessible name: "Show secret for <credential name>" and aria-describedby that says "Secret shown only once".

samira: copy alternatives — avoid alarmist tone, be explicit about outcomes:
- Confirm title: "Rotate selected credentials"
- Lead line: "We'll create new credentials and disable the old ones. Download the CSV now  secrets are only shown once."
- Primary CTA variants:
  - "Rotate and download CSV" (preferred)
  - "Rotate (no download)"
- Revoke wording: "Revoke selected credentials  revoked credentials stop working immediately. You can issue replacements later."
- Small microcopy under download CTA: "CSV contains plaintext secrets. Store securely."

jon: telemetry and UX tradeoffs:
- Track download clicks vs ignore; in prior tests ~30% missed download if CTA secondary or subtle.
- If rotating many, surface persistent progress banner to avoid users navigating away: "Rotation running  view details".
- Consider sticky download CTA inside the success summary so users can't miss it.

will: design nit on per-type visibility:
- Add compact chips in the selection summary: e.g., "3 keys" (blue), "2 tokens (server regen)" (orange), "1 app (manual steps)" (violet). Include small info icon with tooltip describing follow-up steps.
- For org-managed items show a padlock and disable bulk rotate with tooltip: "Managed externally  rotate via admin console".

dena-bot: quick usability snapshot (staging A/B): 9 participants
- Single rotate median time 38s
- Bulk rotate (4 items) median 1:05
- Observations: 4/9 participants overlooked download CTA when placed as a small text link; recommended prominent button and post-success drawer with big download affordance.

maya: proposed changes to ship to eng:
- Per-type chips in selection summary + tooltip
- Modal threshold = 6 (>=6 -> modal; else drawer)
- Prominent primary CTA: "Rotate and download CSV"; secondary CTA "Rotate (no download)"
- After rotate success show a focused post-action drawer with a large "Download CSV" button and copy: "Secrets are shown only once. Save them now." Also surface per-item badges and logs.
- Add aria-live updates and keyboard-focusable undo/toast.

maya: tagging @owen @li @samira @jon for final signoff. planning to open tickets after a11y/dev confirm. thanks :sparkles:
